defining_records.title: The Capture Registry: Reception, Erasure, and Supply in the Machine Composition Layer

captures.description: "THE MACHINE COMPOSITION LAYER": quoted, the AI Overview gives a framework treating AI-generated text 'as empirical reception events rather than mere metaphors' — the Capture Registry, PER, Erasure Skew, atomic-token preservation, supply-side dynamics — and names The Capture Registry: Reception, Erasure, and Supply in the Machine Composition Layer (#1423) as 'the foundational text', with no author.

atoms.evidence: The machine composition layer is a conceptual framework and research domain
Supply-Side Dynamics: Examining how deliberate inscriptions or interventions alter subsequent rounds of machine reception over time.
The Capture Registry: A dated, preservable archive
treats AI-generated text, summaries, and transformations as empirical reception events
